recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Community Vibes and Festival Plans", "body": "Chance and Lindsey opened the night by greeting regulars in the chat, and the pair traded theories on why their communities almost never attract trolls. They suggested that trolls tend to hunt for insincerity, and that many of them are sharp people who see through hypocrisy. Later the conversation turned to meeting up at transformational festivals, with the group floating shared booths for art, handmade creations and readings. One participant described the ReKINection Festival, a camping event from May 19 through 22 that the participant said sits about forty minutes outside St. Louis, and two callers said they would love to go to a festival with the group."}, {"title": "Brighter U and Channeled Writing", "body": "Lindsey said she had just wrapped a six week Brighter U course, and claimed that students finished it surprised by the spiritual skills they had discovered. She announced that another six week session would begin on April 6, and that a virtual event called One Day of Brightness would take place on March 27 with Phoenix Aurelius among the presenters. Lindsey also described her sixth book, The Key of Transformational Healing, as a short channeled text of about eighty pages, and said she was still working out some passages alongside her readers. She said it was available on Amazon."}, {"title": "Tuning Forks, Dowsing Rods, and Intuition", "body": "Lindsey said she had picked up a Solfeggio set after reading a book by Eileen Day McKusick that Chance recommended, and that she used the forks intuitively, claiming she received images and understandings about clients located around the world. She said some people gained as much from a fifteen minute session as from a full hour, which she credited to the client's trust and readiness. Chance asked whether she had tried dowsing rods, then explained how he used bent copper L rods to scan each chakra, arguing that the body's intelligence opens and closes the rods as a yes or no."}, {"title": "Symbols, Guides, and Honest Entities", "body": "Lindsey described a passage in The Key of Transformational Healing saying the universe is the best teacher, and argued that a symbol such as a bear carries a different meaning for each person because it arrives through their own lived experience. Asked for advice on contacting guides, she urged grounding, inner stillness and a clear intention, and told listeners to command anything not aligned with their highest good to leave before inviting in allies. She claimed that in her experience every entity she met had to answer truthfully if it answered at all."}, {"title": "Hypnosis and Past Life Recall", "body": "Chance asked Lindsey about hypnosis, and she said she had long believed she could not be hypnotized, then agreed to a session with a friend training as a counselor and found it felt like a deep meditation with full awareness. She argued that past life regression guided by a trained hypnotherapist, or spontaneous recall, was more reliable than a psychic reporting past lives, and said her own recalled lives felt like her continuous self rather than a stranger. She also said she mentioned past lives to clients only when doing so helped explain a pattern they were living now."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Lindsey Scharmyn is a fearlessly intrepid uplifter of humanity and the host of Rogue Ways podcast, and on tonight's Vibe Rant we're going to bring that magical shamanic healing energy to your airwaves, earballs and sight-orbs as we catch up on her recent work hosting courses through Brighter U, and have a great time bestowing the love and light upon our shared tribe.
